scope: Bounded source preparation only; no acoustic experiment or independence admission

exposure_review.scope: 852 locally reachable commits; 4468 historical text blobs; local audit metadata and nested archives; 12638 text occurrences / 5802 distinct contents; one malformed historical JSON retained and filename-scanned
limitations: No-hit is not proof of non-exposure; indirect identifiers, missing or remote manifests, unsaved evaluations and unpublished use remain unresolved.
Any filename or declaration mention is conservatively excluded; a mention is not claimed as an actual execution.
SPEAKERS.TXT roster membership alone is not exposure.
All locally reachable refs were frozen at scan start; unobserved remote branches and deleted Git objects were not scanned.
The old development, validation, shadow and training roles remain unchanged; train-clean-5 is not relabeled.

selection.main_assets: 32 original FLAC files and their complete losslessly decoded PCM; 8 x 4s windows are only predefined adapter excerpts, not sufficient validation coverage

role.name: reserved-validation-visible-scope-separated
role.future_use: Requires a separately preregistered acoustic contract; all new originals, full PCM and windows retain this reserved role.

rights_review.code: First-party preparation code uses the repository Apache-2.0 license; existing speech_source.flac_info semantics are reused unchanged.
rights_review.dependencies: Python standard library and an already installed FFmpeg decoder. Record actual executable SHA256, version and -L license output. No package installation or redistribution of the FFmpeg executable.
rights_review.weights: None; no model is loaded or downloaded.
rights_review.data: Exact OpenSLR-12 LibriSpeech dev-clean archive; retained original LICENSE.TXT specifies CC BY 4.0. This does not admit other corpora, weights or test sets.
rights_review.redistribution: Preserve original notices and author/source/license attribution; disclose lossless decoding and any excerpt concatenation. No endorsement. No automatic audio publication.

acceptance: Exact archive byte count, SHA256 and official MD5 before extraction or decoder launch
No links, special members, duplicate identities, unsafe paths, missing notices or roster drift
Persist fixed metadata selection before the first decoder invocation
Decode native mono 16 kHz PCM16 without resampling, gain, filtering, normalization or padding
Verify every complete PCM frame count and nonzero FLAC STREAMINFO MD5; preserve original and decoded SHA256
Reconstruct all excerpt bytes and half-open source spans without invoking a codec in verify
Verify Git controls, archive, original FLAC and all output bytes again before success
Keep failures; no alternate source, retries, quality-driven replacement or historical role change
